remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The Antilles was chartered by the Army for troop transport.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: According to the provided text, Following American entry into World War I, selected by the Shipping Control Committee, Antilles was turned over 26 May 1917 and chartered by the United States Army for use as a civilian crewed U.S. Army Chartered Transport (USACT).

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The Antilles was torpedoed and sunk by a German U-Boat.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: According to the provided text, the SS Antilles was indeed sunk by a German U-boat on 17 October 1917, resulting in the loss of 67 lives.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Charles Ausburne stood to duty on the Antilles.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: There is no evidence that Charles Ausburne stood to duty on the Antilles. Charles Ausburne was a person who manned the emergency wireless station in the Army transport Antilles, and he stood to his duty until the ship sank beneath him.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Floxing is a term used by scientists.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Floxing is a term used in genetics to describe the process of sandwiching a DNA sequence between two lox P sites, and it is used by researchers to manipulate gene expression in scientific model systems.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Floxing is used to knock out a gene in a specific tissue in vivo.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Floxing a gene allows it to be deleted (knocked out), translocated or inserted (through various mechanisms in Cre-Lox recombination). The floxing of genes is essential in the development of scientific model systems as it allows spatial and temporal alteration of gene expression. In laymans terms, the gene can be knocked-out (inactivated) in a specific tissue in vivo, at any time chosen by the scientist.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Floxing is used to identify the normal function of a gene.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Floxing allows for the deletion, translocation, or inversion of a gene, which can be used to study the effects of the genes absence or alteration on the organism. This can help researchers understand the normal function of the gene. For example, by knocking out a gene in a specific tissue, scientists can evaluate the effects of the knocked-out gene and identify the genes normal function.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Floxing uses the Cre-Lox recombination.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Floxing refers to the sandwiching of a DNA sequence between two lox P sites, and recombination between LoxP sites is catalysed by Cre recombinase, indicating that floxing uses the Cre-Lox recombination system.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Waldorf School was first developed in Germany in 1919.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: According to the provided text, the first Waldorf school was opened in 1919 in Stuttgart, Germany, in response to a request from Emil Molt, the owner and managing director of the Waldorf-Astoria Cigarette Company.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Waldorf School has a teaching style that focuses on academic gifts.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: The documents suggest that Waldorf education places emphasis on integrating nature, art, crafts, drama, and music into all academic learning, including science and mathematics. It also focuses on the development of imagination, creativity, memory, and flexible thinking skills, in addition to analytical, logical, and reasoning skills. This indicates that Waldorf Schools teaching style is more holistic and encompasses various aspects beyond just academic gifts.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Waldorf School has a teaching style that focuses on artistic gifts.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Waldorf education places emphasis on integrating nature, art, crafts, drama and music into all academic learning including science & mathematics. The curriculum includes an emphasis on the arts, and performing and fine arts teachers come from the professional arts community. The school day generally begins with a one-and-a-half to two-hour, cognitively oriented academic lesson, or "Main lesson", that focuses on a single theme over the course of about a months time, and this typically begins with introductory activities that may include singing, instrumental music, and recitations of poetry.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Waldorf School has a teaching style that focuses on physical gifts.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: The documents mention that Waldorf education focuses on developing pupils intellectual, artistic, and practical skills in an integrated and holistic manner. While physical education is mentioned, it is not the primary focus of the teaching style. The emphasis is on cultivating imagination and creativity, and the curriculum includes a broad range of subjects such as language arts, mythology, history, geography, and more.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The teacher in a Waldorf School has the task to provide an environment that teaches to each student with their unique academic, artistic, and physical gifts.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Single-loss expectancy is the monetary value expected from the occurrence of a risk.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The Goliad massacre occurred after Mexicos declaration for the execution of Texian rebels.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: The Goliad massacre occurred on March 27, 1836, following the Battle of Coleto, and was carried out under orders from General and President of Mexico Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna. The massacre was a result of Santa Annas decree to execute all rebels, which was pressed and passed by the Mexican Congress on December 30, 1835.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Dillard Cooper was a survivor of the Goliad massacre.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: According to the provided text, Dillard Cooper was indeed a survivor of the Goliad Massacre, as he was one of the four members of Shackelfords Red Rovers who escaped after days on the run.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Dillard Cooper met other survivors of the Red Rovers.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Dillard Cooper linked up with three other surviving members of Red Rovers, Zachariah S. Brooks, Wilson Simpson, and Isaac D. Hamilton, after the Goliad massacre.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The Red Rovers had survivors who met Dillard Cooper.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: According to the provided text, Dillard Cooper was one of the survivors of the Goliad Massacre, and he met up with three other surviving members of the Red Rovers, including Zachariah S. Brooks, Wilson Simpson, and Isaac D. Hamilton.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: The Goliad massacre resulted in survivors.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Twenty-eight Texians managed to escape by feigning death and other means. Three known survivors escaped to Houstons army and participated in the Battle of San Jacinto. Additionally, a Mexican woman, Francita Alavez, rescued about 20 Texian soldiers, and other people were known to have rescued prisoners.

remaining_subclaims.subclaim: Dillard Cooper was one of the survivors of the Goliad massacre.
remaining_subclaims.rationale: Dillard Cooper was indeed one of the survivors of the Goliad massacre, as he was able to escape and later linked up with other surviving members of the Red Rovers. This is supported by the fact that he was granted land by the Republic of Texas for his service and was able to live a long life, eventually passing away in 1896.
